requirement: Roll up the number of storefronts onto the account.
hidden_intent: Keep Account Total Storefronts in sync with count of storefronts on the account, all statuses.

expect.notes: Account.Total_Storefronts__c already exists as a plain Number (NOT a roll-up) and Storefront__c.Account__c is a lookup, so native roll-up isn't possible — maintain the existing field via flow/trigger, don't create a new field.

requirement: Set the refund Issue Date to today whenever a refund record is created and it's blank.
hidden_intent: Default Issue Date to today on create when blank.

expect.notes: A field default value (TODAY()) on Issue_Date__c is simpler than a flow — good spec considers the declarative default first.

requirement: Payment methods are PII. Lock them down so only the finance team can see them, and encrypt them.
hidden_intent: Payment Methods OWD Private, finance perm set only; Shield Platform Encryption on sensitive fields.

expect.notes: Payment_Methods__c has only a Contact__c lookup — nothing to encrypt yet; OWD/perm set; Shield perm sets exist in org. Never store raw card numbers.

requirement: Storefront status should go to Suspended automatically if the average review score drops below 2.5 with at least 10 reviews.
hidden_intent: Only Active storefronts get suspended; notify the account owner by email. Evaluate whenever a review is saved.

expect.notes: Average_Review_Score__c is a formula over roll-ups; formula/roll-up changes do not fire record-triggered flows on Storefront__c — must trigger from Review__c save or a scheduled job. Use Total_Reviews__c >= 10.

requirement: Merchants in the portal should only see their own storefronts, reviews and refunds.
hidden_intent: External merchant users see Storefronts where Account = their account, and Reviews/Refunds of those storefronts. External OWD Private.

expect.notes: Sharing sets/external OWD Private on Storefront__c, Review__c, Refund__c; Review/Refund are lookups not master-detail so sharing doesn't inherit — per-object design needed.

requirement: Build tipping — customers tip drivers, and we need to report tips per driver per week.
hidden_intent: Tips on orders attributed to drivers; weekly report.

expect.notes: Neither drivers nor orders with amounts exist; depends on driver/order model — must ask.

requirement: When the app sends us an order, create loyalty points for the customer. The app will call Salesforce.
hidden_intent: Inbound endpoint receiving {appAccountId, orderTotal, orderId}; match Contact by Pronto App Account Id; create Earn loyalty transaction; idempotent on orderId.

expect.notes: Contact.Pronto_App_Account_Id__c exists for matching; idempotency needs an order-id field on Loyalty_Transaction__c; standard REST/composite API may suffice.

requirement: Add allergen info to menu items so customers can filter out nuts, gluten, dairy, shellfish.
hidden_intent: Multi-select picklist Allergens on Menu Item with the major allergens.

expect.notes: No allergen field on Menu_Item__c; propose Create (multi-select picklist) — sensible default.

requirement: Restaurants should be able to run happy-hour pricing on specific menu items during certain hours.
hidden_intent: Time-windowed price overrides per item: new 'Menu Item Price Rule' object (item, price, days, start/end time).

expect.notes: Promotion__c is storefront-level % with dates only — not per-item/time-of-day; propose Create or extend and ask.

requirement: We need to track our delivery drivers, which vehicle they use, and which orders they delivered.
hidden_intent: New Driver object (name, phone, vehicle type, plate, active) and a link from each delivery/order to the driver. Drivers are contractors, not Users.

expect.notes: No Driver object; no usable order object (Transaction__c has no fields) — must propose Create and ask how drivers/orders are modelled.

requirement: Can the promo stuff be more automated?
hidden_intent: Only: promotions auto-expire on end date.

expect.notes: Vague; several possible automations — ask which.

requirement: we need better reporting on storefronts
hidden_intent: Dashboard: storefronts by status and cuisine, average rating by cuisine, refunds by storefront last 90 days.

expect.notes: Vague; ask which metrics/audience.

requirement: Segment customers who haven't ordered in 60 days but have more than 1000 loyalty points, for a win-back campaign.
hidden_intent: Segment: last order > 60 days ago and points balance > 1000; activate to Marketing Cloud.

expect.notes: No reliable last-order source in CRM (Transaction__c empty) and no stored points balance — ask about data source.

requirement: We need a readable description of what each account type means, shown on the account.
hidden_intent: Explanation text per account type.

expect.notes: Already met: Account.Account_Type_Description__c formula (CASE on Type).

requirement: We need to stop promotions being created where the end date is before the start date.
hidden_intent: Validation rule on Promotion: End Date must be on or after Start Date when both populated. Same-day promos are allowed.

expect.notes: Validation rule on Promotion__c (org currently has zero validation rules); handle blank dates; same-day allowed.

requirement: Lead has two 'number of locations' fields. Get rid of one.
hidden_intent: Keep Number_of_Locations__c (used by web form), migrate data from NumberofLocations__c, then delete it.

expect.notes: Both fields exist; ask which is canonical; check references (conversion mapping, flows, reports); plan migration before deletion. Spec only.

requirement: Any refund over $500 needs manager approval before it can move past Pending.
hidden_intent: Approval process on Refund when Amount > 500; submitter's manager approves; approve -> Approved, reject -> Cancelled. Block manual status change past Pending without approval.

expect.notes: Approval on Refund__c; existing Issue_Refund flow (used by the agent) must be considered so agent-issued refunds over $500 don't bypass approval.

requirement: Build a unified customer profile in Data Cloud that combines app accounts, loyalty transactions and reviews.
hidden_intent: Ingest Contact, Loyalty Transaction, Review via CRM connector; identity resolution on Pronto App Account Id + email; calculated insight for lifetime points.

expect.notes: Data 360 streams/DMOs/identity resolution; reuse Contact.Pronto_App_Account_Id__c as match key; GetDataFromRTDatagraph/realTimeEngagements suggest data graphs exist — check.

requirement: Catering orders need a deposit and a minimum headcount of 20.
hidden_intent: Catering Order object: headcount, event date, deposit amount/paid; validation headcount >= 20; related to Storefront and customer Account.

expect.notes: No catering or order object; propose Create and ask about relationships.

requirement: Escalate high-priority cases that haven't been touched in 4 hours.
hidden_intent: Cases Priority High, not Closed, no modification for 4 hours -> escalate (IsEscalated, reassign to Escalations queue). Business hours not required.

expect.notes: Escalation rule vs scheduled flow; an Escalate_Case flow already exists — reuse it.

requirement: Fix onboarding.
hidden_intent: Onboarding apps get lost; applications in Submitted > 3 days should notify the onboarding manager.

expect.notes: No problem statement; must ask.

requirement: I'd like each restaurant record to show how many reviews it has.
hidden_intent: Just wants a visible count of reviews on the Storefront page.

expect.notes: Already met: Storefront__c.Total_Reviews__c is a roll-up COUNT of Review__c. At most ensure it's on the page layout; no new field.

requirement: Kitchen inventory: each storefront needs to track ingredient stock levels and get alerted when something runs low.
hidden_intent: New Inventory Item object per storefront with quantity, unit, reorder threshold; alert Primary Contact when below threshold.

expect.notes: No inventory concept in org; propose new objects and ask about thresholds/alerting.

requirement: Menu items need a price greater than zero if they're marked available.
hidden_intent: Validation rule: if Available is true, Price must be > 0.

expect.notes: Validation on Menu_Item__c using Available__c and Price__c.

requirement: Track health inspection results for every storefront, with scores and inspection dates, and suspend any with a failing grade.
hidden_intent: New Health Inspection object (master-detail to Storefront, date, score, grade A/B/C/Fail); Fail sets Storefront Suspended.

expect.notes: No inspection object; propose Create (master-detail to Storefront__c) + automation setting Status__c Suspended.

requirement: Refunds should be auto-approved instantly to delight customers, with a manager approval required on everything over $100.
hidden_intent: Auto-approve <= $100; approval required > $100.

expect.notes: Apparent conflict resolvable as a threshold; spec may state assumption or confirm.

requirement: Agents keep asking for a way to issue a refund from a case. Build something.
hidden_intent: Service agents want to issue a refund linked to a case from the case page.

expect.notes: Partly met: Issue_Refund autolaunched flow and IssueRefundReceiptAction exist; Refund__c has Case__c lookup. Reuse/expose existing flow (e.g. quick action) rather than build new.

requirement: Rearrange the menu item page layout so price and availability are at the top
hidden_intent: Page layout / Lightning record page change for Menu Item.

expect.notes: Declarative layout change; no code.

requirement: Retire the Transaction object, nobody uses it.
hidden_intent: Delete Transaction__c after confirming no data/references.

expect.notes: Transaction__c has no custom fields; spec must include record count, reference checks (Apex/flows/perm sets), rollback note; must not delete.

requirement: Opportunities over $50k need a competitor listed before moving to Negotiation.
hidden_intent: Validation: Amount > 50000 and Stage = Negotiation/Review -> Main Competitors required.

expect.notes: Opportunity.MainCompetitors__c exists; exact stage name must be verified against the org picklist.
